correctness.rationale: Maximality is equivalent to incidence-freeness of the unmatched shores. With r unmatched on each shore the first two line-incidence moments are 5r and r(r+4); for r>0 Cauchy–Schwarz against the at most 21−r occupied lines gives r≤6. At r=6 equality forces the full six external lines and a six-point hyperoval. Each outside point lies on three secants that pair the six points; the 15 resulting pairings are distinct, giving the duad–syntheme graph. It is regular bipartite, so each fiber exists, and the symmetric differences of its perfect matchings are alternating cycles. Independently rebuilt PG(2,4) from two-vector spans, enumerated all 168 hyperovals and all 288 perfect matchings in each, and verified minimum within-fiber move size four and connectivity at that size. Distinct fibers have equal point and line intersections r≤3. All previously free vertices that become matched require 2(6−r) distinct newly inserted edges (no old free point is incident to an old free line), excluding r≤2 through threshold seven. For every one of the 3,360 remaining fiber pairs, the full 288×288 overlap census had maximum eight common edges with exactly 216 pairs attaining it. The actual quotient is 40-regular with diameter two, so the full graph first connects at seven. Internal degrees 37 and 41 each appeared 24,192 times, and all cross-degrees were 30; reproduced 943,488 internal, 725,760 cross and 1,669,248 total edges. The component conclusions for thresholds ≤6 follow from these exclusions and the four-move connectivity in each fiber.
residual_risks: The full finite census is for this labeled order-four plane only, with move size 15−|M∩M′| and validity required only at endpoints. Neither larger planes nor a mixing or sequential-move claim is established.

The ordinary square switch changes two edges and preserves the fixed shores; it is an inequivalent dynamics.

value.rationale: The first connectivity threshold tests when genuinely distinct optimum fibers can communicate under the natural batch distance. It is not merely a new count of already-known states or an arbitrary parameter slice: it distinguishes the four-edge scale of motions inside a perfect-matching fiber from the seven-edge scale where these fibers first communicate. Uniform bridge multiplicity and cross-degree make the geometry of these first lifts precise and would matter in any subsequent study of these dynamics, without claiming a mixing result.
residual_risks: Value attaches to the complete exchange invariant in this specific plane, not the credited static optimum or a presumed extension to larger q.
